summary: Verified via Crossref that scout territory.seed_doi 10.1126/science.472739 is the wrong Science article (Marwell 1979, careers in academia). Corrected seed_doi to Newman & Frisch (1979) primary DOI 10.1126/science.462174, recorded pass3_correction provenance, and refreshed in-dataset SHA-256 pins for scout_manifest.json.
root_cause: Step-1 scout dossier transposed digits in territory.seed_doi (472739 vs 462174), likely conflating two August–September 1979 Science DOIs; reference JSON and BibTeX already held the correct Newman primary DOI.
evidence: Crossref GET https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1126/science.462174 → title "Dynamics of Skeletal Pattern Formation in Developing Chick Limb", Newman, 1979-08-17
Crossref GET https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1126/science.472739 → title "Geographic Constraints on Women's Careers in Academia", Marwell, 1979-09-21

validation.name: DOI provenance consistency
argv: import json,re,pathlib; m=json.load(open('datasets/limb_chondrogenesis_turing/scout_manifest.json')); r=json.load(open('datasets/limb_chondrogenesis_turing/limb_chondrogenesis_turing_reference.json')); b=pathlib.Path('datasets/limb_chondrogenesis_turing/paper_citations.bib').read_text(); doi='10.1126/science.462174'; assert doi in b; print(m.get('seed_doi') or m.get('territory',{}).get('seed_doi') or 'see report', doi)

validation.name: Embedded scout_manifest SHA-256 matches file
argv: import hashlib, json; from pathlib import Path; sm=Path('datasets/limb_chondrogenesis_turing/scout_manifest.json'); ref=json.loads(Path('datasets/limb_chondrogenesis_turing/limb_chondrogenesis_turing_reference.json').read_text()); assert ref['metadata']['scout_manifest']['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(sm.read_bytes()).hexdigest(); print('ok')
